title: 🔆🔅 Downing of a "Lucas" Drone by the Army Navy's Air Defense in the South of the Country
text:
🔆🔅 Downing of a "Lucas" Drone by the Army Navy's Air Defense in the South of the Country"

"🔹 A short while ago, an aggressor enemy "Lucas" drone was shot down by the air defense systems of the Army's Naval Forces in the southern part of the country."

"🔹 Army Public Relations: A short while ago, an aggressor enemy "Lucas" drone was intercepted and successfully struck by the naval air defense systems—operating under the country's integrated air defense network—in the south of the country, resulting in its complete destruction.
